Definition
[Jacobian $J\mathbf f$] ↗ def:gradient-matrix-df-square-notation 1. appC:C.5-def-2\group Inverse and Implicit Function Theorems

The Jacobian is \[ J\mathbf f :=|\det D\mathbf f| =\left|\frac{\partial (f^1,\ldots ,f^n)}{\partial (x_1,\ldots ,x_n)}\right|. \]
